bull_bear.body:
- Net worth grew from Rs. 139.69 Cr in FY23 to Rs. 305.48 Cr in FY26, with EBITDA rising from Rs. 20.92 Cr in FY23 to Rs. 97.84 Cr in FY26 and PAT from Rs. 17.58 Cr in FY23 to Rs. 50.14 Cr in FY26.
- Debt is partly raised through listed NCDs — two debt ISINs are listed on NSE (INE0JYY07018 / symbol 975MWL29 and INE0JYY07026 / symbol 10MWL29) and the deck carries a dedicated "NCD Issue" section.
- Credit rating upgraded to ACUITE "A", with NCDs rated ACUITE A+ and listed on NSE.
- The Board approved a 10:1 stock split "to improve liquidity and broaden shareholder participation"; shareholding stands at 66.50% promoter & promoter group and 33.50% public as on 30-06-2026.
- The deck states no dividend or payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Established in 1995 and described as "one of India's leading fully integrated stainless steel manufacturers, with operations spanning the complete value chain from scrap melting to the production of value-added stainless steel long products and seamless pipes & tubes".
- Integration is the stated moat: "Fully integrated operations from scrap melting to value-added stainless steel products enable greater cost efficiency, quality control, and operation flexibility, while ensuring zero processing waste through the recycling and reuse of all manufacturing waste generated."
- Products are marketed under two flagship brand families — one for long products and one for tubular products — serving critical applications in food and dairy equipment, superior grade utensils, oil and gas, aerospace and medical devices.
- Certification-led quality positioning: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, plus PED & MERKBLATT (melting div.), IBR and EIL approvals.
- Market reach is stated inconsistently in the deck: the company overview claims presence in "30+ Countries & 15+ states across India" and the competitive-advantage slide says "Exports across 30+ countries", while the closing contact slide says "Around the World, Exporting to 20+ Countries".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Listing] The Company migrated to the NSE Main Board in September 2025 and listed on the BSE Main Board in May 2026, described as achieving "the landmark distinction of being listed on both the NSE and BSE Main Boards".
- [Governance] Promoter-family led — Mr. Vipin Prakash Mangal (Chairman, 37+ years), Mr. Chandragupt Prakash Mangal (Managing Director, 8+ years) and Mr. Chanakya Prakash Mangal (Director, 10+ years), with four independent directors and Mr. Mohit Agrawal as Whole Time Director & CFO.
- [Industry] The deck's industry section attributes demand to infrastructure, railways, urban and transportation projects, the "Make in India" ecosystem, and trade policy measures including "calibrated import regulations and safeguard mechanisms".
- [Stock data as on 30-06-2026] Share price Rs. 375.75, market capitalisation Rs. 1,116 Cr, 29.70 million shares outstanding, face value Rs. 10.00, 52-week high Rs. 395.50 and low Rs. 158.00 — stated before the approved 10:1 split takes effect.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Mangalam Worldwide Limited as one of India's leading fully integrated stainless steel manufacturers, spanning the complete value chain from scrap melting to value-added long products and seamless pipes & tubes across four Gujarat plants with 190,000 MTPA of installed capacity.
